seiyuuLife.title: Voice Actress Life Restart
seiyuuLife.intro: It starts the day you leave high school: a dozen-plus forks, some of them branches, and that is your whole career.
seiyuuLife.rule1: Pick one option at each fork; acting, singing, fame, stamina and luck all move. Tokyo, voice school or going home - the very first pick sends you down different roads.
seiyuuLife.rule2: Run your stamina down to nothing and you take the burned-out path - you cannot outwork everything.
seiyuuLife.rule3: Each bonus rolls a small random swing, and events cut in along the way; some options are gambles with the odds and both outcomes printed on them.
seiyuuLife.rule4: You finish with one ending, the working voice actress whose path resembles yours most, and how rare your ending is.
seiyuuLife.odds: Rarity {{value}}% - that is how few random lives land here

start.title: The day you graduate, you decide to...

tokyo.label: Move to Tokyo and chase it

local.label: Stay home and take a day job

agency.title: Three agencies want you after your first audition

school.title: Two years at voice school - how do you spend them?

top.label: Stay until the last light is off

partTime.label: Class by day, part-time job by night

club.label: Join a drama club, get on stage

workshop.label: Grind the basics in a small theatre

firstRole.title: Your first role is on the table

crew.title: Someone asks: want to form a unit?

route.title: Where do you put your energy next?

live.title: The tour offer and your throat cannot both win

steady.label: Cut some dates, keep the pace

side.title: What do you do with the free hours?

hold.label: Grit your teeth and keep it together

dissolve.label: Disband and go back to voice work

break.title: A clip of you blew up online

decline.label: Lie low and skip the heat

deny.label: Deny it and call it a rumour

layLow.label: Stop work for a few months

indie.label: Pick only the work you love

charity.label: Give the time to charity and fans

final.title: How do you want to end this?

retire.label: Bow out and move behind the scenes

burnout.name: Your body gave out first
burnout.desc: The schedule ran into next year and your throat quit before you did. You stopped, and never went back to that pace.
burnout.reason: She too only learned to brake after a hospital stay.

teacher.name: You became a teacher
teacher.desc: You turned booth experience into lesson plans, and a few of your students became who you once meant to be.
teacher.reason: She trains rookies now and teaches more than she records.

award.name: An award winner
award.desc: You wore your most formal outfit to the ceremony, and when your name was read, the loudest cheer came from the colleagues who had been in the booth with you.
award.reason: She has an industry award to her name - the work and the name remembered together.

anison.name: An anime-song diva
anison.desc: A label released your single, the venues grew with every tour date, and more people came to hear you sing than to watch the shows.
anison.reason: She debuted as a singer and stood on stages bigger than any booth.

overseas.name: A hit overseas too
overseas.desc: From Shanghai convention halls to Los Angeles venues, the light sticks came in different colors but they spelled your name.
overseas.reason: Outside her home turf, she has an audience of her own overseas.

star.name: A household lead
star.desc: Your name leads the credits, and people shout the character's name wherever you go.
star.reason: Leads all the way up, with both skill and luck on her side.

legend.name: A living legend
legend.desc: Juniors say "you know, the one" before they remember your actual name.
legend.reason: She has stayed at the very top for decades.

variety.name: A variety regular
variety.desc: Viewers may never have seen your anime, but they have seen your face on TV.
variety.reason: People remember her face before her voice.

streamer.name: The voice of streaming
streamer.desc: The chat is livelier than any comment section, and clips keep the editors busy.
streamer.reason: She is the one whose streams get clipped into memes.

idol.name: The face of a project
idol.desc: You became the face of that project: handshake events run past midnight and every set list has your name on it.
idol.reason: In that project she is the one people remember first.

band.name: The one at the mic
band.desc: Thirty shows in a row, and you still finished the last song with a wrecked voice.
band.reason: She is the one standing behind the guitar in a band.

radio.name: A late-night regular
radio.desc: Every week at that same hour, listeners wait for your opening line.
radio.reason: The voice-only name on the radio is hers too.

game.name: The hidden lead of games
game.desc: Players may not recall your face, but they remember the line you delivered.
game.reason: She voiced a game character people never forget.

freelance.name: Freelance and formidable
freelance.desc: No agency banner, so the work had to speak: nobody dared pay you late.
freelance.reason: No major agency - she stood on her own work.

workhorse.name: The major-agency workhorse
workhorse.desc: Colleagues came and went; your attendance sheet never left that wall.
workhorse.reason: At a big agency, she is the one who is always there.

unsung.name: Always in the credits
unsung.desc: Not many jobs, but never none. When the credits roll, your name is still up there.
unsung.reason: Rarely named first, but always in the credits.

rainyAudition.title: A storm on audition day
rainyAudition.desc: The last train is cancelled and the floodwater is already on the subway steps.

options.taxi: Take a taxi across half of Tokyo

viralClip.title: A booth clip leaked online
viralClip.desc: Someone secretly recorded you humming between takes; it went around tens of thousands of times in a day.

options.ride: Ride it and post one yourself
options.deny: Ask the agency to take it down
options.double: Turn it into a short-form series

injury.title: You twisted your ankle in rehearsal
injury.desc: The premiere is in three weeks; the doctor wants at least two of them off your feet.

options.rest: Rest properly and move the premiere
options.push: Get a shot and go on stage

watcher.title: Someone followed you home
watcher.desc: They have stood outside your building for three nights with a phone in hand.

options.police: Call the police and move out
options.ignore: Ignore it, do not make it bigger
options.announce: Say it out loud on stream

senpaiDinner.title: A senior invites you to dinner
senpaiDinner.desc: A lead-role director who is currently casting is sitting at the same table.

options.go: Go and make a good impression
options.perform: Get up and audition on the spot

tabloid.title: A weekly caught you at a convenience store
tabloid.desc: The cover headline is already written; it hits the stands tomorrow morning.

options.silent: Say nothing and let it pass
options.quit: Quit for real and post about it

gameOffer.title: A game wants you as the lead
gameOffer.desc: The producer says the budget is small but the role carries the whole story.

newManager.title: The agency swapped your manager
newManager.desc: The new one wants to change the pace of everything you do.

options.resist: Stick to how you have worked
options.solo: Take side jobs behind her back

fanLetter.title: A three-page fan letter arrives
fanLetter.desc: Tiny handwriting, and the last line reads: because of you, I got through that winter.

voiceLoss.title: Your vocal cords are bleeding
voiceLoss.desc: Three months without a break; the doctor warns that singing on could leave permanent damage.

unitClash.title: The unit is fighting
unitClash.desc: There is only so much budget, and who gets what is now on the table.

options.sideMajor: Side with whoever is more popular

tvOffer.title: A variety show wants you as a regular
tvOffer.desc: Prime time, once a week, and it eats every Wednesday.

options.decline: Decline and stay on voice work

memeClip.title: Your stream clip became a meme
memeClip.desc: The sticker pack is everywhere and the comments are all shouting your name.

options.deny: Remind everyone you are a voice actress first

longRest.title: A whole month suddenly free
longRest.desc: For the first time this year the calendar is empty, and your manager says the time is yours to spend.

options.rest: Sleep it off and take nothing
options.trip: Travel a little and see old friends
options.hustle: Take two more jobs while it is quiet

dreamRole.title: The role you waited years for
dreamRole.desc: You know the source material by heart, the audition notice is in your inbox, and the field is crowded.

options.take: Do the homework and play it safe
options.audition: Gamble on the boldest read you have
options.recommend: Audition alongside a partner and cover each other

awardNominee.title: A best-voice-actress nomination
awardNominee.desc: Your phone rang all day when the shortlist went up. The ceremony is next month.

options.attend: Go and sit in the front row
options.video: Send the organizers a thank-you video
options.skip: Skip it and stay in the booth

anisonOffer.title: A label wants to release your single
anisonOffer.desc: The producer called right after hearing your character song and wants to write something for your voice.

options.accept: Sign it and cut a debut single
options.unit: Release it together with your unit
options.decline: Focus on voice work for now

overseasInvite.title: An invitation from overseas
overseasInvite.desc: They say the venue is booked, the fan-subbers will be there, and flights and hotel are covered.

options.go: Fly out and meet that audience

fanMeeting.title: Your fans want to hold a meet-and-greet
fanMeeting.desc: Banners, cheers, a raffle - they have planned it all and are waiting on your yes.

options.small: Keep it small and talk properly
options.gift: Skip the event and mail signed gifts

result.title: How your life ended up
result.shareSummary: My life landed on "{{ending}}" - what is yours?
